theme: Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152
highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the new Graphite GPU backend and upgrades the engine to Skia milestone m152.
highlights_body: Alongside Graphite bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, this preview adds backend-neutral async pixel readback, a Vulkan Silk.NET package with expanded test coverage, and containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server (with FreeType-based font support there). Several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes are also included.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine is now built from the m152 branch, and the release line was further updated with upstream m151/m152 stability fixes.
New bindings expose the Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving consumers an alternative to the Ganesh backend on supported platforms.
SKImage and SKSurface gain RequestReadPixels, an async API for reading pixels back that works consistently across GPU backends.
A new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package is available, with Vulkan tests now also running on Android and Linux.

Fixed a use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator by rooting the owning SKRegion, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and related With* methods by rooting the pixel source, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on the SKImage.Create raster failure path.

SKData.SaveTo avoids a double buffer copy, GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on its null-terminated path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its uniform lookup map, all reducing allocations and native round-trips on hot paths.
A reflection-based skip-registration check in HandleDictionary is now cached instead of recomputed on every call.

bullets.lead: Nano Server font support via FreeType
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp now uses FreeType for font rendering on Nano Server, where the platform font APIs used elsewhere on Windows are unavailable.
New containerized CI test legs cover Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and Windows native builds no longer pin a specific Windows SDK version by default.

bullets.lead: Windows native build environment initialization streamlined
bullets.detail: The MSVC developer environment is now initialized once per native build instead of repeatedly, speeding up Windows native builds.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Added FreeType-based font support for Nano Server
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Streamlined MSVC environment initialization for Windows native builds
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the 4.152.0 line with the Skia m152 engine upgrade, the new Graphite GPU backend bindings, backend-neutral async pixel readback, the Vulkan Silk.NET package, containerized Azure Linux/Alpine/Nano Server test legs, FreeType-based Nano Server font support, and several native use-after-free and memory-leak fixes.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1 ships with this release, alongside the containerized-testing and binding-generation infrastructure work in this cycle.
